entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Instruction of how to get the dotnet runtime associated to a given sdk release is missing #50471

Closed

  • restore operations using dotnet 10 sdk result in ssl errors #50396
  • NetCore App 2.1.12 produces Case-insensitive *.deps.json file for case sensitive operating systems #3449
    Discussion
  • Add Ability to specify nuget.config file for dotnet test #10383
    Backlog
  • Compiling projects within symlink broken #10346
    Discussion
  • [Infrastructure] GH action for updating baselines on existing PRs #49729
  • Support packing file-based apps #49369

PullRequests

Created

  • Add repositoryAlias parameter to CI configuration #50478
  • Disable the test leg in CI build #50477
  • Update `.editorconfig` template to set `dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups` to `false` #50476
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2775101 #50474
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Update the testhost root rather than the installer root to avoid impacting the installer msi #50473
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix first-run experience output interfering with completion commands #50472
    breaking-change, Area-CLI, needs-breaking-change-doc-created
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50470
  • Add alpha branding #50468
    Area-CodeFlow

Merged

  • Enabled automatic CI for both RC1 and 10.0.1xx #50422
  • Add more methods to installer interface #50475
  • Fix first-run experience output interfering with completion commands #50454
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Update ProcessFrameworkReferences and ResolveAppHosts to not look for runtime-specific assets for the any RID #50455
  • Remove directory option in dotnet test #50434
  • Remove FileLoggersCount from MSBuild telemetry event #50432
  • Add GitHub Actions workflow for updating static web assets baselines #49730
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50438

Updated

  • Set RoslynAssembliesPath #50433
  • Make packtool targets light up only on pack #50445
  • Fix Microsoft.IO.Redist versions #48819
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Update overlay SDK to include the stage0 downlevel implicit versions (#50344) #50418
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50427
  • Move generating implicit framework defines to a target. #45696
    Area-NetSDK
  • [release/10.0.1xx] [StaticWebAssets] Use property for original resource #50453
  • Fix: Unsupported maccatalyst attribute is getting applied to child attributes but not accounted parent child attributes merge #50334
    Area-Infrastructure
  • MSBuild Server dogfood (#12120) #50389
